answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A falcon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tundra of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work.
